newsitem.title: UK: London tea auction attracts strong general demand.
newsitem.headline: London tea auction attracts strong general demand.

text.p: Strong general demand was seen at Monday's tea auction where coloury Assams met improved competition with prices often two to four pence dearer, the official report said.
Plainer types remained firm, the report added.
Brighter east Africans gained several pence, while coloury mediums sold well and frequently appreciated two to three pence.
The offshore sector was met by good demand. Better liquoring Kenya and Zimbabwe advanced but others were barely steady.
The next auction will be held on Monday, Dec 9.
